approvedDelta.reason: Keep Flow screenshot selection and review inside the Flow shadow host with matching theme and modal geometry. Label capture as Screenshot instead of repeating the Flow step count, and center capture headings, choices and annotation guidance. Reuse the existing capture and annotation engine; legacy feedback continues through its original root. Browser checks cover submission progress, color isolation, area and element selection, retake, mobile review, close and focus restoration. Production release remains a separate operator action.
